title: Showy Chewy Biscuit Bites
description: A deliciously chewy biscuit with a creamy cheese center and a showy briny topping, perfect for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour and chewy cookie pieces.
Add briny cheese spread and cream cheese to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into small squares or use a cookie cutter to create shapes.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with showy grated parmesan.
